game_concept: A action defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Moonstone Terrace, a terrace of moonstone: the relic hunter must handle echo phantoms while practicing lists. Core idea – Slice Slicer: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Moonstone Terrace: a terrace of moonstone
core_gameplay_loop: In Moonstone Terrace, repeat each round: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group. Each round, echo phantoms strike the heart stone, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the slice_ok value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the heart stone from echo phantoms in Moonstone Terrace: keep the slice_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 50-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: slice_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 50-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 3 (intro tier): Slice Slicer
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Slice Slicer' (Week 7 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Moonstone Terrace'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how slice_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against echo phantoms in Moonstone Terrace.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 50 seconds while slice_ok > 0.
